# Welcome {.unnumbered}

These notes cover how to visualize data.
Each page works through one plot, with R and Python code side by side.
The code runs when the site is built, so every figure comes from the data shown.

## Pages

- [Plotting a Binary Outcome](chapters/binary-outcomes.qmd): a rug and two histograms for a 0/1 outcome and a continuous feature.
- [Choosing Colors](chapters/colors.qmd): how far apart a palette's closest two colors are under simulated color vision deficiency.

## Formats

Each page is available in these formats:

- an HTML web page;
- RevealJS slides, at the same address with `-slides` added to the page name;
- a PDF handout and a Word document.
